sources.title: Bronisław Kaper student file, RP 6854
sources.researchNote: This is an aggregate file citation, not an item-level portrait record. The materials already documented from the file include portraits, matriculation and study records, and the police certificate of 21 April 1920 recording Kaper’s religion as Mosaic. The linked student record-book reproduction is identified as fols. 38–39. The structured year 1920 refers to the documented student materials, not an independently established date span for the complete file.
